data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'al-wa-ka', meaning 'to be a companion or friend'. In Islamic tradition, Alvi is a name given to one who is a loyal and faithful companion. The name Alvi carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alvi usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
